items.title: What Should Skyworks Solutions (SWKS) Investors Watch After Its Index Removal?
items.summary: Skyworks Solutions (NasdaqGS:SWKS) is set to be removed from the PHLX Semiconductor Sector Index, affecting its role in that benchmark.
